Asie.texte: In Asia, milk output totaled close to 460 million tonnes, a 2.4 percent increase from 2023.

Europe.texte: In Europe, milk output reached 236 million tonnes in 2024, up 0.8 percent from 2023 level.

Amérique du Nord.texte: In North America, milk output remained largely stable at 112.5 million tonnes, down 0.2 percent compared to 2023.

Afrique.texte: In Africa, milk production stood at 53.9 million tonnes, almost the same as in 2023

Océanie.texte: In Oceania, milk production reached 30 million tonnes, up 1.6 percent from 2023
